gloss: you see; the thing is (feminine explanatory)

definitions.gloss: you see; the thing is; that's why (feminine explanatory emphasis)
definitions.explanation: A sentence-final combination of the explanatory の and the emphatic よ, used in feminine speech. It presents the statement as an explanation or background the listener did not know, rather than as bare new information.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧のよ。
⟦{昨日|きのう}→昨日：00859_kinou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{熱|ねつ}→熱：01690_netsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がらない→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧のよ。
examples.english: The thing is, my fever hasn't gone down since yesterday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ばたばた→ばたばた：05353_batabata⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧のよ。
examples.english: My son is getting married next month, so I've been rushing around with the preparations.

notes:
Attaches to the plain form of verbs and i-adjectives. After a noun or na-adjective, だ becomes な: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧なのよ, ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧なのよ.

REGISTER:
Feminine speech. The neutral equivalent is んだ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧, and the polite equivalent is んです⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧. のよ is gentler than わ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧: わ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧ pushes the assertion at the listener, while のよ frames it as background information being shared.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- んだ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧: explanatory emphasis — neutral to masculine, the everyday equivalent
- ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧: feminine explanatory agreement — seeks confirmation instead of asserting
- わ⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧: feminine assertion — no explanatory nuance
